description: Phase 4: Wearable + Calendar Integration and Living MindMap Upgrade - user_integrations table with OAuth flows, context signals attachment to journal analysis, MindMap node extraction upgrade (50 candidates, cosine >= 0.85 dedup), node-click side panel with Sheet component, and 1k+ node performance (clustered view).
steps: Create migration supabase/migrations/20260601000004_phase4_wearables_mindmap.sql with: CREATE TABLE user_integrations (id uuid PK, user_id uuid references auth.users on delete cascade, provider text check (in apple_health/oura/google_fit/google_calendar/apple_calendar), access_token_enc text, refresh_token_enc text, token_expires_at timestamptz, scopes jsonb default '[]', calendar_mask_titles boolean default true, connected_at timestamptz default now(), UNIQUE(user_id, provider)), RLS: select/update/delete where user_id=auth.uid(), insert with check user_id=auth.uid(). ALTER journal_analysis ADD COLUMN context_signals jsonb. ALTER mind_nodes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_seen_at timestamptz default now(). CREATE INDEX idx_mind_nodes_user_lastseen on mind_nodes(user_id, last_seen_at desc).

Create supabase/functions/fetch-context-signals/index.ts: internal helper called from analyze-journal. Accepts user_id, reads user_integrations for connected providers, fetches last 24h data from each (Oura REST API, Google Fit REST, Google Calendar). 5-second total timeout, 3 retries with exponential backoff per provider capped at 30s. Returns { sleep_minutes, hrv_avg, meeting_count_24h, meeting_minutes_24h, source_versions }. Respects calendar_mask_titles (only count+duration when masked). Falls back to null on failure (no error surfaced to user).

Update supabase/functions/analyze-journal/index.ts: after auth and before AI call, if user has connected integrations, invoke fetch-context-signals inline with 5s timeout. Pass result to composeSystemPrompt as contextSignals. Add CONTEXT_BLOCK to prompt composition that includes sleep/HRV/meeting data when available. Persist context_signals on journal_analysis row.

Create src/components/app/IntegrationsCard.tsx for Settings: lists providers (Oura, Google Fit, Google Calendar, Apple Health as 'coming soon'). Each shows Connect/Disconnect button. Connected providers show connected_at date. Calendar providers show 'Mask event titles' toggle. Gate behind useFeatureFlag('wearable_integrations') and tier >= premium.

Create OAuth connection flow helpers in src/lib/integrations.ts: functions to initiate OAuth redirect for Oura, Google Fit, Google Calendar (standard OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow). Callback handler that stores tokens via edge function or direct insert to user_integrations.
Add IntegrationsCard to Settings.tsx (gated by premium tier).

Update supabase/functions/update-mind-map/index.ts: (1) Raise max entities from 8 to 50 candidates per analysis. (2) Raise dedup threshold from 0.84 to 0.85 cosine similarity. (3) Add node label length validation (1-80 chars). (4) On extraction failure, return success (non-fatal) and log mindmap_extraction_failed. (5) Update last_seen_at on existing nodes.

Update src/pages/app/MindMap.tsx: (1) Replace the custom AnimatePresence detail panel with a shadcn Sheet component (slide from right) for the node-click side panel. Show entry references in reverse chronological order with 200-char excerpts and analysis summaries. (2) Add 1k+ node performance: when graphData.nodes.length > 1000, default to clustered view (top 500 by frequency) with a 'Show all' toggle. (3) Gate enhanced features behind useFeatureFlag('living_mindmap') and tier >= premium. Free tier sees existing behavior without side panel.
Add i18n keys for integrations UI and MindMap upgrades (provider names, connection status, calendar masking, cluster view labels).
acceptance_criteria: user_integrations table created with RLS and OAuth token storage
Settings shows Integrations card for premium users with Connect/Disconnect for each provider
analyze-journal incorporates context signals into AI prompt when integrations are connected
MindMap extracts up to 50 node candidates per analysis
Node click opens Sheet side panel with entry references
Graphs with >1000 nodes default to clustered view (top 500)
Free tier sees existing MindMap without upgraded features
verification: Run npm run build and confirm zero errors
Run npm run test and confirm tests pass
